Proof
Sheet

A bread explorer for Gabe's Breadsheet. A proof sheet shows every frame at once; proofing is the dough's last rise.

Views

Crumb portraits Dough map Pantry web Bake schedule Bread lineage

Highlight

24 recipes from gabestein/breadsheet on Underlay, v1.3.0, read Nov 18, 2026. A sketch, not a product.

Crumb portraits

Flour at the center, then each ingredient as a ring outward, with area matching its share of the dough. Holes in the crumb grow with the water. Lean loaves stay small; pound cake comes out more than twice the size of a baguette.

Sort

Dough map

Across: effective hydration, counting the water in starter, milk, and eggs. Up: richness, the fat, sugar, and egg added per 100 of flour. Lines join each bread to its closest relative by overall formula.

Pantry web

Flour, water, salt, and starter are in almost all of them, so they sit in the middle unlinked. The threads show what is left: the ingredients that give each bread its character. Hover an ingredient or a bread.

Bake schedule

Pick when you want to eat. Each recipe is planned backward from that moment, using the times in Gabe's method steps. Solid blocks need you at the bench; pale ones are waiting. Red circles mark hands-on steps that land between 11 pm and 7 am.

Ready
Plan

Times come from the method text; where a recipe gives a range we use the middle. The tooltip flags blocks where the recipe gives no time and the length is our estimate. "Use the fridge" swaps in the overnight option where a recipe offers one. Gabe's Fulkornbroyt has no method steps in the collection yet.

Bread lineage

The same 24 recipes placed in the history of their breads, from hearth loaves to this decade's gluten-free and discard recipes. Quotes are Gabe's headnotes; red lines trace one bread growing out of another.

History notes and lineage lines are context written for this sketch. They are not part of the collection and would need Gabe's review.
